title: Computational Methods & Problem-Solving Case Studies
summary: A quantitative problem-solving research programme that develops disciplined hypothesis formation, mathematical formalization, strategic reasoning, mathematics in finance, and reproducible computational analysis through source-grounded case studies and a gated Rust workbench. The initial pilot is Jane Street Pressure Points; it remains independent of OFRL-IB-001 and makes no claim that a puzzle is a financial model or trading strategy.
